product_titles.YN-P-01: Yunnan: From Old Towns to Shangri-La

days.title: The Great Wall · Might of an Empire
days.description: Discover the formidable military genius of the Great Wall at Mutianyu, where legendary fortifications follow the mountain ridges.

days.title: The Summer Palace · An Imperial Retreat
days.description: Explore the poetic, man-made paradise of the Summer Palace, with imperial gardens shaped by philosophies of harmony.

days.title: Two Paths Beyond the Mountain City
days.description: Choose between Wulong’s dramatic karst landscape and the sacred rock art and riverside streets of Dazu and Ciqikou.

alternatives.title: Karst Cave Exploration
alternatives.description: Descend into a hidden cave to discover subterranean wonders and natural geological art.

alternatives.title: Via Ferrata Climb
alternatives.description: Take the cliffside iron path for a secured vertical climb through Yangshuo’s karst landscape.

days.title: Two Ways to Discover Xiangxi
days.description: Choose waterfall towns and riverside lanterns, or a cliffside adventure paired with architectural fantasy.

days.title: Guiyang & Qingyan · A Literary Landmark and a Stone Town
days.description: Discover Guiyang’s literary heritage at Jiaxiu Tower, then explore the stone streets and Ming Dynasty character of Qingyan Ancient Town.

days.title: Miao Silver & Riverside Stories
days.description: Meet the living traditions of Miao silverwork in Shidong and the tranquil merchants’ port of Xiasi.

days.title: Zhaoxing · In the Heart of Dong Culture
days.description: Discover drum towers, wind-and-rain bridges and the cultural landscape of a Dong village.

days.title: Xiaoqikong · An Emerald Karst Sanctuary
days.description: Follow sapphire rivers and cascading waterfalls through the karst landscape of Xiaoqikong.

days.title: Kunming · Stone Forest and Old Streets
days.description: Discover Kunming’s Stone Forest and the Dian-style architecture and local life of Kunming Old Street.

days.title: Dali · The Living Heritage of the Bai Kingdom
days.description: Explore Dali’s cobblestone lanes against the Cangshan mountains and discover the local Bai cultural traditions.

days.title: Erhai to Lijiang · Lakeside Life and Naxi Lanes
days.description: From Erhai’s lakeside landscape to Lijiang’s canals and wooden architecture, discover two distinctive chapters of Yunnan’s local life.

days.title: Into Shangri-La · Gorge, Faith and Sacred Art
days.description: Travel through Tiger Leaping Gorge to Shangri-La and Dukezong, with Thangka painting introducing the highlands’ sacred art.

days.title: Pudacuo · A Highland Sanctuary
days.description: Explore alpine wilderness, shimmering lakes and forests before returning to Lijiang.

days.title: Chengdu · History and Contemporary Life
days.description: From Wuhou Shrine and Chengdu Museum to Taikoo Li, discover the city’s historical stories and contemporary streets.

days.title: Pandas, Tea and Old Lanes
days.description: Meet Chengdu’s pandas, explore the tea-house life of People’s Park and wander the traditional lanes of Kuanzhai Alley.

optional_descriptions.涮肉: Discover Beijing’s hotpot tradition over a meal selected to complement your journey.
optional_descriptions.烤鸭: Explore one of Beijing’s signature culinary traditions with a Peking duck dining experience.
optional_descriptions.胡同酒馆: Pause in a hutong bar and experience another side of the old city’s local life.
optional_descriptions.外滩用餐: Pair your exploration of Shanghai’s waterfront with a meal by the Bund.
optional_descriptions.法租界小酌: Take time for a drink amid the former French Concession’s tree-lined streets.
optional_descriptions.本帮菜: Discover the flavours of Shanghai’s local cooking as part of your visit.
optional_descriptions.盖碗茶: Slow down over a traditional covered-bowl tea and enjoy a moment of local life.
optional_descriptions.两江夜游: See Chongqing’s riverside cityscape from the water after dark.
optional_descriptions.洪崖洞火锅: Experience Chongqing’s hotpot culture alongside the atmosphere of Hongyadong.
optional_descriptions.三下锅: Taste a local Tujia hotpot tradition during your Zhangjiajie journey.
optional_descriptions.冰啤收尾: Round off your market exploration with a relaxed beer stop.
optional_descriptions.非遗体验: Explore Lingnan craftsmanship through a heritage experience; the specific activity will be confirmed separately.
optional_descriptions.夜市大排档: Discover the lively atmosphere and local flavours of Guangzhou’s night-market dining.
optional_descriptions.地道粤菜: Explore Cantonese culinary traditions over a locally arranged meal.
optional_descriptions.串串: Discover Chengdu’s casual dining culture through its skewer-style hotpot.

introductions.BJ-P-01: Encounter Beijing through the imperial axis, hutong life, the Great Wall and the gardens of the Summer Palace.
introductions.BJ-P-02: Explore imperial Beijing, then discover the rituals and beliefs that shaped the capital’s spiritual life.
introductions.BJ-P-03: Four days reveal Beijing’s imperial architecture, mountain fortifications, old-city life and royal gardens.
introductions.SH-P-01: Explore the contrasts of Shanghai, from classical gardens and the Bund to historic streets and Haipai culture.
introductions.SH-P-02: Three days weave together Shanghai’s garden city, the canals of Zhujiajiao and the history and elegance of its urban neighbourhoods.
introductions.SH-P-03: Combine Shanghai’s city stories and water-town life with a day exploring Disneyland.
introductions.CQ-P-01: Discover Chongqing’s river crossings and hillside lanes, then choose karst scenery or the stone art and old streets of Dazu and Ciqikou.
introductions.CQ-P-02: Journey from Chongqing’s mountain-city streets to Wulong’s karst landscape and the stone art of Dazu.
introductions.CQ-P-03: Follow Chongqing’s mountain-city stories and Dazu’s sacred stone art towards a Three Gorges river voyage.
introductions.XA-P-01: Encounter the First Emperor’s terracotta army, then discover the city walls, markets and Silk Road heritage of Xi’an.
introductions.XA-P-02: Explore Xi’an’s imperial legacy and ancient-capital life before discovering the gardens and nighttime atmosphere of its Tang-inspired cultural landmarks.
introductions.YS-P-01: Drift, cycle and walk through Yangshuo’s river valleys, karst peaks and historic riverside settlements.
introductions.YS-P-02: Pair Yangshuo’s river landscapes with a day of outdoor adventure and hands-on cooking.
introductions.ZJJ-P-01: From the heights of Tianmen Mountain to the sandstone pillars of the forest park, discover two sides of Zhangjiajie’s dramatic landscapes.
introductions.ZJJ-P-02: Explore Zhangjiajie’s mountain worlds, then choose the cultural towns of Xiangxi or a cliffside adventure and architectural fantasy.
introductions.GZ-P-01: Discover Guangzhou’s trading networks and wholesale markets through an insider-led sourcing journey.
introductions.GZ-P-02: Explore Lingnan craftsmanship and Guangzhou’s local life before a day in the landscape of Gu Long Gorge.
introductions.GZ-P-03: Follow Guangzhou’s cultural and historical chapters, with time for the outdoor landscape of Gu Long Gorge.
introductions.CD-P-01: Discover Chengdu through its historical landmarks, pandas, tea-house culture and traditional city lanes.
